summary: Loves propulsive, character-driven crime and thriller stories that hook from episode 1 (Breaking Bad, The Wire, Sopranos, Ozark, Yellowstone, The Departed, Black Bird, The Old Man, Terminator 2, Severance) and warm or sharp comedy (Shrinking, The Office, Fleabag, Ted Lasso). Liked Justified, The Americans, Moneyball, Spotlight. Quits slow-burn or cold, ironic shows (Succession, Slow Horses) and passes on heavy grief dramas (Manchester by the Sea, Sound of Metal, Adolescence, The Body).
